verdict.rationale: The docs show Computer running delegated multi-step tasks autonomously. A task can keep running after the call returns: the client receives progress notifications and resumes later by reusing the thread_id. It also pauses for approvals or auth when needed. That covers the 'runs autonomously in the background' half of the story, but nothing in the evidence shows setting up standing automations such as schedules, recurring runs or event triggers. Missing for 10: documented scheduled or recurring automations, event-based triggers, an automation management UI or API, and hands-on corroboration of unattended background runs.
